en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a ruined stone city gate with an arched entrance in a defensive wall. The structure is partially collapsed, with vegetation growing on the masonry. A dirt road passes through the arch, where several people and a cart or carriage are visible in the distance. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Constantinople. Edirné Capou" along with additional text in Arabic/Ottoman script. A web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the bottom right.
